description: Introduce the Mission Framework. Transcribed from runtime/system/ROADMAP.md § M0001 (no new architecture).

done_when: Mission Contract shape is defined and loadable.
Missions can be registered and enumerated.
A mission definition can be loaded from disk.
A mission definition can be validated.
Mission lifecycle states and transitions exist.
Completed missions are recorded in an append-only ledger.

definition_of_done: ODG can load, validate and track missions.
completion: Mission ledger updated with a proven M0001 entry.
write_set_basis: V15.5 MEASURED output write-set (strace -f of a real governed isolated wave run, 2026-11-23; see docs/odg/evidence/V155_REAL_WAVE_EVIDENCE.json). Paths are relative to the RUN-OUTPUT ROOT (per-run ODG_RUN_OUTPUT_DIR under wave isolation; runtime/generated otherwise). Enforced in isolated wave mode: an actual file outside this set => WRITE_SET_VIOLATION (not verified). NOT listed: the shared mission-ledger.json (+ its fleet/locks claim), which is runner SHARED_STATE, lock-serialized, at most one entry per run.
